title: Implement Right-Angled Number Triangle
description:
Write complete, compilable C code that prints the following pattern:

1
12
123

Your code will be compiled and evaluated using an online C compiler.
explanation: A nested loop where the outer loop iterates rows from 1 to 3, and inner loop prints column j from 1 to i.
hints: Outer loop runs from i = 1 to 3
Inner loop runs from j = 1 to i, printing j
